retrievalProfile.description: A romantic close-up portrait of a man and woman within a tilted frame, featuring soft-focus lighting and vibrant magenta neon-style glows.

recipe.visualDefinition: A romantic, intimate portrait of a man and woman facing each other, set within a slightly rotated rectangular frame. The image is characterized by a soft, warm lighting on the subjects, contrasted against a cool blue textured background. A distinctive magenta airbrushed glow outlines specific elements like the woman's hand and the album title, creating a 'hot' neon effect.
coreVisualRelationships: Tilted inner frame against a static outer border
Magenta glow accents contrasting with blue background
Diagonal text alignment following the frame tilt
Detailed jewelry and headpieces as focal textures
coreInvariants: Magenta neon-style airbrushed glow around subjects and text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The duo occupies the central 80% of the inner frame in a medium close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The point of near-contact between the two faces in the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top-left text, down the diagonal tilt of the frame, to the intimate connection of the subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Cool blue textured space surrounds the tilted inner frame.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and white shirt
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the magenta accents against muted, atmospheric values in the photography.

letterConstructionRules: Diagonal baseline following the frame tilt
Magenta outer glow applied to specific characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initials 'P' and 'H' are rendered in a gestural, brush-stroke style
The number '2' is large, stylized, and glowing
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Geometric sans-serif paired with expressive, hand-drawn script initials.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric weight and wide tracking potential

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a romantic portrait of a soul duo in 70s attire, man in white shirt, woman with beaded headpiece, inside a tilted frame on a blue textured background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add wide-tracked geometric sans-serif text on a diagonal baseline with magenta neon glow effects and brush-style initials.

verificationChecks: Is the frame tilted approximately 5 degrees?
Does the magenta glow appear on the text and the woman's hand?
Is the tracking on the main text sufficiently wide?

adjustableVariables: Tilt angle of the inner frame
mustRedesign: Avoid exact replication of the specific artist names
Do not use the specific record label logos in the corners
postGenerationChecks: Check for the presence of the thin diagonal line under the text
Ensure the magenta glow has a soft, airbrushed falloff
Verify the subjects are in profile or semi-profile facing each other
Confirm the outer border is a solid, textured blue
recipe.reuseFormula: Romantic Duo Portrait + Tilted Frame + Magenta Neon Glow + Wide-Tracked 70s Sans-Serif
